Main exclusively executes all validation. No tests/imports/lints/builds run by implementer.
1. Review and apply NEW-file patch to isolated source; run project Python lint for both files, fix any findings. Existing lints likely require typing/line-width refinements; source packet unvalidated.
2. Run bounded CPU analytical suite: PYTHONPATH=tools python -m unittest discover -s tools -p test_fixed_history_logits.py. No model/GPU/downloads needed. Deadline 60s, raw text budget 1MiB. Serialized with Main builds/tests/GPU work.
3. Verify CLI accepts exactly one manifest argument and rejects malformed/missing JSON, no outputs written on error. Add valid explicit big-endian fixture if needed; current fixture covers mismatch rejection.
4. Production adapter review remains prerequisite. Do not run a model merely because comparator analytical fixtures pass. No actual quality/operational qualification from this packet. Later A/A calibration and fixed-history paired captures need separate authorized finite supervised runs plus held-out task evaluation; Main owns all execution.
